result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber liability of USD 5M when Kubient processes relevant data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing general-provisions language and is professionally drafted. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after the Term exceeds the playbook and is not necessary to achieve the stated position.
